sources.title: Gemensam ansökan 2026 statistik
sources.covers: Joint application 2026: nybörjarplatser, förstahandssökande, alla sökande, antal som mottagit studieplats. No points columns

notes: Novia publishes yearly application statistics (Statistik_till_webben_2024/2025/2026.pdf on its Ansökningsstatistik / Statistics on Student Admissions page). They contain only places, first-choice applicants, all applicants and the number who received a place. They have no lowest-accepted-points (lägsta antagna poäng) columns, so there are no cutoffs to record. Searched: WebSearch in Swedish (lägsta antagna poäng, betygsbaserad antagning, ansökningsstatistik) and English, plus the Swedish and English statistics pages. The 2024-2026 PDFs were text-extracted and checked for any points columns; none were found. No other Novia cutoff source was found.
